body: [{"streamId":"01a16a84-9877-7297-b6e5-f9cfe822cc37","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Decision.DecisionRecorded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a16a84-9877-7297-b6e5-f9cfe822cc37\u0022,\u0022Scope\u0022:\u0022Project\u0022,\u0022ScopeId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71\u0022,\u0022Statement\u0022:\u0022A project\\u0027s prompt addendum has a hard ceiling of 8000 characters (\\u0060ProjectDecider.PromptAddendumHardMaximumLength\\u0060) that \\u0060--over-cap\\u0060 cannot lift. \\u0060h9k project prompt-addendum set\\u0060 refuses anything longer, with or without \\u0060--over-cap\\u0060, and names the limit, so the escape hatch Decisions Log #218 gave the 4000-character soft cap now covers 4000 through 8000 characters rather than any length. \\u0060ProjectPromptAddendaLoader.TryLoad\\u0060 enforces the same ceiling on the materialized file: it cuts at 8000 characters without splitting a surrogate pair and appends \\u0060ProjectPromptAddendaLoader.TruncationLabel\\u0060. Because \\u0060set\\u0060 can no longer produce such a file, only a forged or replicated one reaches that cut. The rest of #218 still binds: the soft cap stays a judgment call with \\u0060--over-cap\\u0060 as its escape hatch, and the ceiling is the one point where a set is refused outright.\u0022,\u0022OriginIncident\u0022:\u0022Security review idea 6be68ee2, prompt-builders finding 3 (task c8695b54, PR #663, merged 2026-09-30). \\u0060--over-cap\\u0060 lifted the 4000-character cap with no upper bound and the loader had no bound at all, so an owner could record an addendum of any length, and a forged or replicated ledger file (unsigned, with a forgeable over-cap marker) could splice unbounded content into every prompt its builder composes.\u0022,\u0022Supersedes\u0022:[],\u0022Provenance\u0022:{\u0022RecordedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022RunId\u0022:null,\u0022TaskId\u0022:null,\u0022Attendance\u0022:\u0022Unobserved\u0022,\u0022IsFromRun\u0022:false},\u0022RecordedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-23T20:47:17.08461\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022LegacyId\u0022:null}","originEventId":"e67c142f-bee6-4746-9fd7-309b5ebee223","originSequence":120386,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-23T20:47:17.154702+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
